author: opencode-worker-2
text: Worker-2 bisect results (decisive): (1) minimal ZTEST-only native_sim build (CONFIG_ZTEST + PRINTK + LOG + LICHEN + LICHEN_LINK) — NO assertion; (2) adding CONFIG_NETWORKING=y + NET_IPV6 + NET_L2_DUMMY + SERIAL + RING_BUFFER + COAP_SERVER/896 (with LICHEN_LINK removed entirely!) — ASSERTION FIRES at prio==NUM_PREEMPT. So the offender is ZEPHYR-side networking infrastructure (net TC RX/TX threads, net mgmt thread, or the Zephyr coap_server service thread), NOT LICHEN code: even a build with zero LICHEN subsystems beyond the module registration hits it. Details: NUM_PREEMPT=15, NET_TC_THREAD_PREEMPTIVE=y, TX/RX_COUNT=1, Zephyr coap_server thread prio = K_PRIO_PREEMPT(14)=14 (valid); the prio-15 thread must come from another Zephyr networking component whose priority tracks NUM_PREEMPT_PRIORITIES (suspects: net mgmt (net_mgmt.c:422 uses NUM_PREEMPT-1=14, valid), socket service, or the Zephyr coap retransmit loop). NOT investigated further this round (timebox). The puck-ns build passes with the SAME Zephyr chain — its distinguishing delta: CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP=y + LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_STANDALONE=y + LICHEN_COAP_KEYS=y (LICHEN coap files replace Zephyr's server thread path) and NUM_PREEMPT=15. Next worker: try CONFIG_NET_TC_THREAD_COOPERATIVE=y or NUM_PREEMPT=16+NUM_COOP=16 on the failing conf, or grep zephyr subsys/net for K_PRIO_PREEMPT(NUM_PREEMPT_PRIORITIES) off-by-one; ALSO note the Zephyr coap_server K_THREAD_DEFINE uses THREAD_PRIORITY from subsys/net/lib/coap/coap_server.c:23-25 — with COOPERATIVE that's K_PRIO_COOP(15) = -16 (valid); with PREEMPTIVE 14 (valid). Remaining suspects in workspace zephyr: net_mgmt.c:422. LICHEN code is exonerated: the assert fires with LICHEN_LINK=y removed and no LICHEN runtime in the image.
